subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` argument plus global/per-agent subagent config default after the resolver bug is fixed?
rationale: The patch adds model-facing tool semantics, operator config defaults, persisted restart behavior, and message-routing semantics where repository policy requires explicit maintainer intent beyond the mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept Opt-In Parent Routing
options.body: Land this PR or an equivalent after normalized per-agent lookup coverage is fixed, default channel behavior remains unchanged, and final checks are refreshed.

options.title: Per-Spawn Only First
options.body: Keep only the model-facing per-call option now and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Defer Native Routing
options.body: Leave orchestration on the existing callback workaround until maintainers choose a broader subagent handoff contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Opt-In Parent Routing
recommendation.body: Land this PR or an equivalent after normalized per-agent lookup coverage is fixed, default channel behavior remains unchanged, and final checks are refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history in the `sessions_spawn`, spawn-planning, subagent docs, and canonical issue-shaping boundary.
